notes: Village of Howells, fiscal year ended 9/30/2025 (filed as FY2026 file name). Cash basis; governmental funds statement (pp4-5) Total Governmental Funds 2025 column; business-type from Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds (pp7-8) Total Proprietary Funds 2025 column. Governmental roll-forward: 827,980 + 615,140 - 699,445 + sale of assets 4,818 = 748,493 (fund balances, p5; they equal cash and receivables less due to other funds). Business-type: no single printed receipts/disbursements totals, so totals computed (receipts 483,676 + 14,380 + 5,675 = 503,731; disbursements 286,914 operating + 743 debt service + 1,052,500 capital outlay = 1,340,157, which equals Statement of Activities business-type expenses p2). Business-type 'measure' is cash-basis net position (800,924 to 809,830, includes investments 96,586 and due from other funds 57,388). Business-type debt proceeds 843,782 are printed as Proceeds from long term debt (p8); Statement of Activities (p2) shows loan proceeds 506,269 plus capital grants 337,513 for the same Water Fund money. Interfund transfers among enterprise funds (Sewer in 316,000 = Water out 206,000 + Trash out 110,000) net to 0. Governmental funds have no transfers. Business-type operating expense lines (contractual, utilities, repairs, other supplies) split by column (p7): Apartment Fund part coded housing, Water/Sewer/Trash part utilities; personal services has no Apartment amount. Balance sheet uses the Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis, Primary Government 2025 Total column (p1); there are no liabilities. Governmental ending/beginning are total fund balances from the governmental funds statement (p5). Detail: General Fund expenditures from the Combining Schedule of Operating Expenditures by department (p17) in place of the budget schedule's expenditure section (p9; the revenue section from p9 is used); department capital outlay recorded as category capital outlay, not itemized; Street, Debt Service, Keno, Water, Sewer, Trash and Apartments from their budgetary comparison schedules; blank/dash lines not recorded. Debt service fund spending split principal 95,000 and interest 12,650 (+400 fee line) using the governmental funds statement. Trash Fund prints no total revenues line. Read pages 1-17 of 17

report_discrepancies.note: Proprietary funds statement (p8) prints Water Fund 'Proceeds from long term debt' 843,782, but the Statement of Activities (p2) shows the same money as loan proceeds 506,269 plus Water capital grants and contributions 337,513 (843,782 - 506,269 = 337,513). Recorded as printed on p8 (business_type.debt_proceeds 843,782).
